evidence.title: Extend.Domains — Domain intelligence for any name you highlight.

name: Extend.Domains
summary: Free open-source browser extension: highlight a domain for registration, DNS, parking, site preview, archive history and a quality score.
description: A free, open-source browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and Firefox: highlight a domain on any page and a side panel reads public, keyless endpoints — registry (RDAP) registration dates and status, DNS records over DNS-over-HTTPS, parking detection, a preview parsed from the site's first 32 KB, the first Wayback snapshot and a locally computed quality score from six signals, plus warnings for mixed-script lookalikes. No backend, no API keys, no account and no trackers; results cache for 24 hours.
contains: highlight a domain, right-click Look up, or press Ctrl+Shift+L
panel cards: registration, DNS, parking, site preview, archive, quality score
local quality score from 6 signals with a per-component breakdown
no backend, no API keys, no account, no trackers; 24 h local cache
Chrome/Edge/Brave/Arc 116+ and Firefox 140+; free and open source
eight reorderable sidebar cards; weights and detection rules editable
availability: an authoritative 404 means unregistered, other failures stay unknown
build from source with git, Node 22.6+ and npm
